message.content:
This vertical editorial illustration features a magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large white capital letters across the upper third. Above this, text reads "CELAH-CELAH ISLAH GOLKAR" and "ADA APA DENGAN DAHLAN ISKAN." Below the main title, the date "8-14 JUNI 2015" is visible. 

The central image depicts a large group of men standing close together in heavy rain. Most are shirtless, wearing shorts or lungis. They hold various plastic bottles and metal plates to catch falling rainwater. One man in the foreground, kneeling or squatting, holds a clear plastic bottle. Another man nearby holds a shallow metal plate. Their skin appears wet and glistening. To the left, white text reads "LUKA ROHINGYA" above "Cerita tentang mereka yang terusir. Reportase Tempo dari Rakhine, Myanmar."

At the bottom left, a barcode sits beside the price "RP 39.500" and the URL "WWW.TEMPO.CO". The background consists of more men receding into the dark, rainy atmosphere. The left edge of the cover features a solid red vertical stripe.
